0022600119.text: The Washington Wizards (2-1, 1-0 on the road, 3rd in the Southeast and 6th in the East) visit the Charlotte Hornets (2-1, 2nd in the Southeast and 7th in the East) in the fourth game of Washington's season, and both teams are on a one-game winning streak. Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery). There are no games yet between the teams in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost 0-4, including a 129-112 loss in Washington on February 22, 2026.
